gates_before_any_deploy_step: Sergio approves creating a no-traffic revision (external state change)
run from the host that holds gcloud auth (deploy-host); confirm the active project with: gcloud config get-value project
confirm service account, secret mount and BIDPILOT_SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION env are inherited (deploy from source keeps them unless flags override)

commands.0_inspect_current: gcloud run services describe bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --format='value(status.latestReadyRevisionName,status.traffic)'
commands.1_build_and_stage_no_traffic: cd <checkout of fix/grand-finale-product-20260903 at 994f61697004baf2d18effcf2231565141cac3fe> && gcloud run deploy bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --source . --no-traffic --tag finale --quiet
commands.2_readback_tagged_preview:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' https://finale---bidpilot-demo-tbauoylpra-uc.a.run.app/ ; then load /, /?tender=R26BK01680611-000, /?walkthrough=1 signed-out and confirm Open/Closed tags, KST deadlines, REVIEW + 4 gaps, PURSUE replay counts
commands.3_promote_after_sergio_approval: gcloud run services update-traffic bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --to-latest
commands.3b_optional_keep_instance_warm_for_final: gcloud run services update bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --min-instances 1   # separate approval; reverses with --min-instances 0 after the event
commands.4_production_readback: repeat step 2 against https://bidpilot-demo-tbauoylpra-uc.a.run.app and then flip the evidence headers to DEPLOYED AND VERIFIED
commands.rollback: gcloud run services update-traffic bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --to-revisions bidpilot-demo-00010-fjt=100

executed.after_event: gcloud run services update bidpilot-demo --region us-central1 --min-instances 0
